tasks.description: Add an 'Export to CSV' button on the sales report page. This button should initiate a download of the currently displayed report when clicked.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sales report page is loaded, when the 'Export to CSV' button is clicked, then a download of the report is initiated.

tasks.description: Develop a backend endpoint that generates the CSV for the requested report and streams the response to the client. This should handle large reports efficiently without buffering the entire file in memory.
acceptance_criteria: Given a large sales report, when the export endpoint is called, then the response is streamed to the client without significant memory usage.

tasks.description: Implement a feature that allows users to choose which columns to include in the export before downloading. The generated CSV should include only the selected columns, in the displayed order.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sales report page with column selection, when a user selects specific columns and initiates the export, then the downloaded CSV includes only the selected columns in the correct order.

tasks.description: Encode the CSV per RFC 4180 standards. This includes quoting fields containing commas, double quotes, or newlines, and escaping embedded double quotes by doubling them.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sales report with fields containing commas, double quotes, or newlines, when the report is exported to CSV, then the fields are correctly quoted and escaped according to RFC 4180.

tasks.description: Ensure the first row of the exported CSV contains the human-readable column names for the selected columns.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sales report with selected columns, when the report is exported to CSV, then the first row of the CSV contains the human-readable names of the selected columns.

tasks.summary: Integrate export button with backend endpoint
tasks.description: Connect the 'Export to CSV' button with the streaming export endpoint, ensuring that when the button is clicked, it initiates the correct export process based on the current report and user selections.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sales report page with the 'Export to CSV' button, when the button is clicked, then the export process is initiated correctly, using the streaming endpoint and respecting user column selections.
